days.title: High Peaks and Botanical Enclaves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: La Resinera
stops.detail: The main enclaves of botanical interest are represented by high peaks, valleys, and ravines, with the most characteristic locations being the southern slope of the Sierra de Tejeda, Sierra de Játar, La Resinera, the upper basin of the Green River and Sierra Cázulas, Sierra de Nerja, and the Sierras of Cómpeta and Enmedio.

stops.name: La Maroma
stops.detail: The highest area (La Maroma) suffers from a massive influx of visitors.
